title: The Lantern Fair
notes: Mara and I watched the paper lanterns drift across the lake. We promised to return next summer.

title: Library return
notes: Return The Moon Atlas to the north branch before Friday.

title: Rowan Vale
notes: Met Rowan at the observatory open house. Interested in amateur astronomy and old maps.

title: First sunrise
notes: The year began with frost on the windows and a long walk before breakfast.
